summary: Dating Video-Profil Feature Testing Complete. Backend video profile endpoints (upload/stream/delete) working correctly via curl. Frontend Video-Profil card visible with record button. All regression tests passed - existing dating features (Voice Intro, Boost, AI cards, Nearby, Crossed Paths, Matches, Likes, Discover) still functional.
